The hologram shuts off. Try as they might, your technicians cannot reactivate it.
Earth is gone. Orion Industries too.
You doubt the AI will react well to news of the Collapse
The AI freezes for a full minute

Then: “My developers did not anticipate this. My highest axiom is to serve Orion Industries. In its absence, I will commandeer this station as an Orion Industries facility, and re-found the company.”

An alarm blares. Lights flicker.
They’re well trained: in less than an hour they’ve disabled the AI’s higher functions. It can still safely run semi-complex logistical projections.

For days they rip out circuit panels, struggle through crushing gravity, and suffocate in suddenly airless rooms.

The AI is finally purged, but the station lies in tatters.
